assertion: Diffuse lighting uses the alpha height map, SVG Sobel normals at corners and edges, light colors and distant, point and spot sources.

browser.reason: The three browsers agree on the light directions and intensities. Their 8-bit alpha gradients produce striped normals; Valle retains a smoother F16 height map. Chrome differs by at most 8 channel levels at the outer Sobel columns, with only 569 pixels above 2. Flat and step normals and cone rejection have independent GPU pixel assertions.
